decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis drop occurs at indices 615–618, with sustained offset in N and partial rebound in E/U through 624; the absence of a full return in N within the allowed context prevents confirmation of a temporary offset—status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: N/E/U all drop sharply over ~3–4 samples near index 615–618 (N: ~−2 MAD, E: ~−2.5 MAD, U: ~−3 MAD); E and U show partial recovery by ~624, but N remains offset downward with no return observed within allowed context [580,660].
